strategy.universe_name: S&P 100-style large-cap list with PIT S&P500 membership + tradability filter

research.note: Research-only long/short backtests (multi-factor, walk-forward ML): 100% long + 100% short. Paper trading uses risk_limits.max_gross_exposure (1.0, long-only).
research.universe_note: Research eligibility = valid price + min history + month-end S&P500 membership (S&P100 subset proxy). Residual survivorship: removed names absent from today's TICKERS are still missing. Paper trading uses the same eligibility when filtering signals.
research.nested_note: Each outer year fold selects among a small candidate set using anchored inner year folds on purged training data only (month-end subset for speed). Default inner score is cost_aware_sharpe: annualized Sharpe of equal-weight L/S period returns after turnover*transaction_cost and stock-borrow/financing. Alternatives: icir, rank_ic. Does not eliminate candidate-menu bias.
research.nested_selection_note: Rule fixed a priori (not tuned on outer results). one_se_fallback: keep nested_default_model unless the best inner candidate's paired per-date advantage (net returns for cost_aware_sharpe, ICs otherwise) exceeds nested_selection_se_threshold standard errors. Alternatives: best (legacy argmax), ensemble_equal (equal-weight blend of all candidates z-scored with training-set prediction stats). nested_inner_name_level_borrow charges inner shorts with the same point-in-time HTB tier panel as the outer book.
research.nested_inner_vol_note: When true (and vol_targeting_enabled), cost_aware_sharpe inner books apply the same causal EWMA/realized vol-target scale as the outer research book, estimated only from each candidate's earlier inner-validation net returns. Inner books also use the outer sector-neutral construction and sector net caps.
research.sector_note: Research L/S demeans scores within sector before ranking and caps |net| sector exposure (default 0.15 of NAV) then restores long/short gross. Sector map is static (data/sector_map.csv) — not historical PIT GICS.
research.beta_note: Research L/S legs are scaled so long-leg beta equals short-leg beta at fixed gross (ratio bounded to [1/R, R]). Betas: trailing beta_lookback_days daily OLS vs beta_benchmark (data/benchmark_prices.csv) ending at the rebalance date, Blume-shrunk toward 1 by beta_shrinkage; names with < beta_min_obs get 1. Alternates with sector caps up to beta_neutral_max_rounds. Design fixed a priori (trial log 41-42). beta_estimator=ewma (default, trial 43, fixed a priori): weighted least squares with weights 0.5^(k/beta_ewma_half_life_days) inside the same window (k = days before the rebalance close); beta_estimator=ols reproduces fe8b173.
research.vol_note: Research L/S scales base gross by target_vol / forecast_vol. vol_estimator=ewma (default): EWMA variance with half-life vol_ewma_half_life periods (lambda=0.5^(1/half_life)); vol_estimator=realized: trailing sample stdev over vol_lookback_periods. Only returns before the rebalance enter the estimate (no look-ahead). Scale clipped to [vol_min_scale, vol_max_scale]. Base gross remains research.long_short_gross_exposure before scaling.

execution.financing_note: Research L/S: name-level borrow tiers (GC/elevated/HTB/special) from ADV$+vol proxy plus optional overrides in data/borrow_tier_overrides.csv — NOT a live locate feed. Flat annual_borrow_bps remains the GC default. Paper/sim is long-only so short borrow is usually 0; daily accrual supports name-level rates if shorts exist.

risk_limits.vol_note: Paper/sim scales long-only target weights by target_vol/forecast_vol of trailing daily NAV returns. Default estimator=ewma with half-life 21 days; set vol_estimator=realized for trailing sample stdev over vol_lookback_days. Default max_scale=1.0 so the engine never requests leverage.
risk_limits.capacity_note: Per-name rebalance trade notional is capped at max_adv_participation * 63-day ADV$. Research constraint diagnostics use simulation.starting_capital as the NAV scale; paper/sim uses live portfolio value. Names without ADV are left uncapped by this rule (the separate min ADV$ liquidity filter still applies).

excluded_symbols.BK: Decision 2026-11-09: keep excluded. The checked-in snapshot has an all-NaN BK column (failed Yahoo download), so BK was never eligible in any committed result. Re-downloading it would change the research universe and results, i.e. a new trial. data_loader.py blanks excluded symbols after every download so refreshes keep the same universe.

data_checks.note: Freshness counts weekdays after the last date up to the as-of date (exchange holidays are not excluded, so it can overcount by a holiday). Misalignment compares price, volume and benchmark date ranges and index sets against price_data.csv. Hashes are SHA-256 of the file with CRLF normalised to LF; update the manifest only after reviewing a re-download (python src/check_data.py --update-manifest).

significance.note: n_trials = sum(trial_increment) in research/trial_log.csv + trial_padding. The log is backfilled from git history (every configuration whose result was observed) and must be appended BEFORE running a new variant. trial_padding=14 is a fixed, documented allowance for unrecorded pre-2026-11 iterations and never-swept researcher choices. V[SR] for each family is the sample variance of that family's reported_sharpe values in the log; information-ratio DSR uses the pooled variance over all reported Sharpes (ir_variance_source=pooled) because no IR history exists. hac_lags=null uses the Newey-West rule floor(4*(T/100)^(2/9)).

paper_tracking.note: Fixed 2026-11-09 from the simulator design, before any tracking result was computed; do not tune on results. Paper vs a frictionless backtest of the previous run's target weights. Holding gap: ~1% cash buffer x a large daily move (~3%) is ~3 bps, so 50 bps (WARNING) / 200 bps (ERROR) per interval and 100 bps per week flag real divergence (missed orders, stale or wrong prices), not noise. Weight deviation 10% of NAV = one fully missed equal-weight position (10 names). Cost ratio: realized per traded dollar vs modeled commission+slippage+half-spread (modeled_cost_bps null = derived from execution, 17 bps); impact is not modeled, so 0.75-2.0 allows impact and rounding but flags a broken cost path. Cost check only when traded >= 0.5% of NAV; gap skipped when > 5% of target weight has no price.
